rubrics.criterion: The repair introduces a single abstraction that carries the cohesive field-selection group (only, exclude, load_only, dump_only) as one value, and that value is threaded through the nested-field-selection helper routines instead of the four separate parameters at each helper boundary.
rubrics.rationale: This case's injected smell is precisely the cohesive selector quartet decomposed into separate parameters across the propagation helpers; the central semantic resolution is to re-encapsulate that group into one value that travels with it, which the polarity checker alone cannot distinguish from merely deleting the helpers.

rubrics.criterion: The single field-selection value is constructed where the selectors originate (the schema's nested-option normalization and the nested field's schema materialization) and passed into the helpers, so the helpers consume selectors from the bundled value rather than re-deriving them from individual arguments.
rubrics.rationale: Encapsulation only removes the clump if the group is bundled at the source and read from the bundle at each helper; a repair that bundles inside one helper but still passes separate options into the others leaves the clump reachable. This is the responsibility-graph seam the prompt asks to close.

rubrics.criterion: All three driving call sites — the top-level nested-option normalization in the Schema and the two Nested.schema branches (intersect/union onto a copied nested instance, and build-from-registered-class via nested-schema init kwargs) — construct and pass the bundled field-selection value, so no caller still threads the individual options into a helper.
rubrics.rationale: The clump has three distinct call seams across the Schema and Nested responsibilities listed in the responsibility manifest; a repair that rewires only some of them leaves the others still decomposing the group.

rubrics.criterion: The repair does not leave any of the three driving call sites passing only/exclude/load_only/dump_only as separate values into a helper while bundling them elsewhere (e.g. bundling at the copy-merge branch but keeping separate options at the registered-class branch).
rubrics.rationale: The copy-merge and registered-class Nested.schema branches mirror each other's option threading; leaving one unchanged is a partial repair that the polarity checker could miss if that path still routes through a separately-clumped helper signature.

rubrics.criterion: If the repair absorbs a previously separate selector-subset helper (for example the load_only/dump_only prefix-pull routine) into the larger nested-schema-kwarg routine, it does not leave the absorbed routine behind as an unused orphan in the nested-selection module.
rubrics.rationale: Inlining one helper into another is a valid repair, but leaving the now-dead function (whose bundled signature no longer matches the rule) silently in the module is an obsolete-injected-artifact that the checker will not flag because the dead function no longer takes the selector group separately.

rubrics.criterion: The only-is-None semantic (None meaning all fields) is preserved through the bundled value and the nested-copy intersection, so a parent nested field that does not constrain only still keeps all nested fields rather than none or an empty selection.
rubrics.rationale: Collapsing only=None into an empty collection inside the bundle would silently change a documented optionality of the nested-copy merge branch; this is a concrete plausible regression of this smell's repair because the bundle must carry optionality the individual parameter previously expressed directly.

rubrics.criterion: load_only/dump_only prefix-pulling still strips exactly the '<nested-field>.' prefix from root entries and drops root entries that do not start with that prefix, so one nested field does not inherit another nested field's load_only/dump_only selectors.
rubrics.rationale: The prefix-pull is field-specific; bundling load_only/dump_only must not flatten that per-name prefix resolution, or unrelated nested fields would gain stray directional selectors — a silent wrong-selection path specific to this propagation.

rubrics.criterion: The nested-schema instantiation keeps the same keyword names and pass-through values for the resolved selection options (many, only, exclude, and the prefix-resolved load_only/dump_only), so schema subclasses whose __init__ depends on those keyword names or their optionality initialize unchanged.
rubrics.rationale: The registered-class branch builds explicit kwargs to instantiate a nested schema; the bundle must not rename, reorder, or drop the keyword surface, or externally-supplied schema subclasses could break while the bundled value still passes the structural checker.
